properties.note: Draft boundary data for Maricopa Consolidated DWID. Built from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim geocoding of named streets visible on three boundary-map images supplied 2026-08-26, cross-referenced against the district's merger history (about.html). NOT a substitute for the district's own GIS/survey data. See per-feature "confidence" and "notes" properties before using this for anything customer-facing.

properties.name: Saddleback Vista
properties.notes: Corners built by combining real Nominatim geocodes for the four bounding streets (N Pala Rd, W Jarrett Rd, N Anderson Rd, W Steen Rd) — border roads are close to true N-S/E-W here, so each corner = the E-W road's latitude paired with the N-S road's longitude. Cross-checked against N Saddleback Vista Ave's own geocoded path, which falls inside this box as expected. Still an approximation, not a surveyed boundary — verify against a district GIS file before treating corners as exact.

properties.name: Valle Escondido
properties.geometry_source: approximate centroid only, not a polygon
properties.notes: Most of the interior street names read off VALLEY MAP FOR PAT.png (W Clayton Rd, W Meadowview Rd, W Reitz Ranch Rd, W Padilla Rd, W Carefree Pl) are not in OpenStreetMap near Maricopa — likely unpaved/private agricultural roads not tracked by the mapping service used. Only N Smith Rd and N John Wayne Pkwy geocoded successfully nearby. This point is the midpoint between those two real geocodes, meant only to place the area on a map roughly — it is NOT a boundary and should not be used for a point-in-polygon check. A real polygon here needs either the district's own GIS/parcel data or manual on-the-ground GPS tracing.

properties.name: Original Maricopa DWID core
properties.geometry_source: approximate centroid only, not a polygon
properties.notes: Source map (IMAGE FOR PAT.png) is a photographed paper plat map with a hand-drawn, irregular (non-rectangular) outline — not a shape that can be honestly reduced to corner coordinates from geocoding alone. This point is the midpoint of W Garvey Ave and W McDavid Rd geocodes, both of which returned real Maricopa-area results. Green Rd also geocoded nearby but with three widely-spread candidate segments, so it wasn't used in this centroid. Treat this as 'roughly here,' not a boundary.
